title: feat: Extract RowActionMenu + add BulkActionBar to ObjectGrid
body:
RowActions and BulkActions specs (`rowActions: string[]`, `batchActions: string[]`) existed in types but had no standalone components. The row action dropdown was inline in ObjectGrid; bulk action bar only existed in ListView with no grid-level support.

### New components

- **`RowActionMenu`** — Extracted from ObjectGrid inline code. Configurable via `rowActions`, `canEdit`/`canDelete`, and action callbacks.
- **`BulkActionBar`** — Shows `"N selected"` + action buttons + Clear. Auto-hides when empty. Renders below grid content.

### ObjectGrid integration

- Replaced inline `DropdownMenu` with `<RowActionMenu>` component
- Added `selectedRows` state tracking via `onSelectionChange` passthrough
- Renders `<BulkActionBar>` in both normal and split-pane paths
- Supports both `batchActions` (ObjectUI naming) and `bulkActions` (spec naming)

### ListView integration

- Passes `schema.bulkActions` → `batchActions` when generating grid view schema
- Passes `onRowSelect={setSelectedRows}` to SchemaRenderer so grid selection changes sync to ListView's state
- Skips ListView's own bulk action bar when `currentView === 'grid'` to avoid duplicate bars (grid renders its own `BulkActionBar`)

### Usage

```tsx
// Grid with row actions + bulk actions
<ObjectGrid schema={{
  type: 'object-grid',
  objectName: 'contacts',
  columns: ['name', 'email', 'status'],
  rowActions: ['archive', 'send_email'],
  batchActions: ['delete', 'export'],
  selection: { type: 'multiple' },
}} />
```

### Tests

26 new tests covering `formatActionLabel`, `RowActionMenu` (standalone + integrated), `BulkActionBar` (standalone + integrated), `onRowSelect` callback propagation with checkbox interaction, and `bulkActions` alias support. All existing grid tests pass unchanged.
